THE INSTANT SUNDAY TIMES BESTSELLER. THE MOST ANTICIPATED SPORTS AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF THE YEAR.

'Horner has an incredible story to tell.' THE TIMES

Discover the gripping, behind-the-scenes account of life at the pinnacle of Formula 1, with Christian Horner’s candid and uncompromising autobiography.
---
Packed with stories featuring motorsport’s biggest characters – Dietrich Mateschitz, Bernie Ecclestone, Adrian Newey, Max Verstappen, Toto Wolff and many others – DRIVE offers a unique and unfiltered perspective from the highest level of the world’s most thrilling sport.

Capturing the intense drama and high-stakes decisions faced when pushing a team to the absolute limits of performance, Christian Horner talks candidly about the twenty years he spent building and running Red Bull Racing. He opens up about elusive drivers, fierce rivals, team dynamics and the many personal battles he fought on and off the track, including the events leading to his shock departure from the team.

Packed with gripping stories and unprecedented insights, Drive is the must-read autobiography for fans who want to know what really happens inside Formula 1.
